source.relative_path: 2018美赛特等奖/E题7篇/E89499-An Evaluation Model of State Fragility related to Climate Change Based on the PSR Model and Entropy Weight Method.pdf

source_quality.notes: the standardization, the proportion, the entropy, the weight and the fragility sum were read from the raster; the variation coefficient was announced but never printed

task_reconstruction: Build a fragility score from stress, status and response indicators weighted by entropy, cut it into fragile, vulnerable and stable, and say when one country crosses the line.

section_map.summary: the derived number and the three ranges
the posed threat and the required tasks
the useful falsehood and the notations
the entropy weights and the fragility sum
the thirty-country test and the three ranges
the first country over five years
the tipping point and the crossing year
the strengths and the owned weaknesses

contributions.summary: a fragility score organized as pressure, state and response
weights taken from the entropy of each indicator
three levels whose boundaries are read off the join of the groups
the route of the climate effect read off the closest pair of series

dependency_graph.relation: the selected indicators are what the entropy is computed on
the weights are what the sum uses
the scores are what the analysis cuts
the upper boundary is the tipping point
the closest channel is one of the drivers

assumptions.summary: the indicators are socio-economic, ecological and climate
the political situation stays stable during the intervention, though it does not
the country follows the trends of the larger set
the indirect climate effect guides the plan but is not measured

data_and_preprocessing.summary: each indicator scaled between its own minimum and maximum
five years of indicators taken from the World Bank
the climate variables borrowed from a published assessment report

verification.summary: the ranking set against a published index on thirty countries
the climate indicators removed and the ranking recomputed
the interventions simulated through the same model

results_trace.summary: fragile from 0.4991, vulnerable from 0.2196, stable below that
the country drops one place when the climate indicators are removed
the second country crosses into fragile in 2028
the plan costs 1,120,070,000 dollars and lowers the score by about 8.9 percent

writing_logic.summary: the cause is defined by refusing the single attribution
a false premise is kept because it helps the arithmetic
a missing number is demoted to guidance
a bias is owned and called unavoidable

language_observations.summary: opens by proposing a model in order to derive a number
flips a one-way effect with vice versa
names the shape of a fluctuation with a letter
closes by replaying the stages in order

visualization_observations.summary: the stress indicators are drawn as a tree of themes and features
the model's rank and the published rank are drawn as two lines
the three groups and the fragility are drawn over five years
the fragility before and after the plan is drawn as two lines

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: keeping a premise the paper itself calls false reads as candour about a convenient shortcut
calling the indicator choice subjective and unavoidable reads as a paper that owns its bias

weaknesses.summary: the variation coefficient is announced and never given a formula
the summary prints the cost with one more zero than the table
the entropy sums over the indicators while the shares run over the years
the three ranges rest on thirty countries and five years

independent_extensions.summary: read the boundary between two levels off the cases that sit on the join
drop one group of indicators and report how the ranking moves

unresolved_questions: the variation coefficient is named and then never printed
the entropy sums to the number of indicators while the shares are taken over the years
the summary gives the total cost with one more zero than the table
the standardization divides by the range of a row while the prose says each indicator
